reviews.text: Our experience with this roofing company in Plano was outstanding from start to finish. A neighbor recommended we reach out when we noticed our roof needed to be replaced. Bryan from their team walked us through every step of the process, explaining things clearly so we always knew what was happening. He took care of almost all the paperwork for us, made sure we had everything ready to go, and even handled everything with our insurance company, which made things so much easier and stress-free. Bryan also helped us choose a new shingle color that we absolutely love, scheduled all the necessary appointments, and kept the whole project moving smoothly. On installation day, the crew arrived early, removed the old roof, and had the new one installed by evening. Their foreman was on site from start to finish, with Bryan and the rest of the team checking in throughout the day. We were amazed by how well they protected our yard, cleaned up as they worked, and left everything spotless—like they were never even there! Every time Bryan or any of the company’s staff visited, they looked professional, wore clean company gear, and were always friendly and polite. They were also flexible and able to stop by on short notice whenever we needed. The office staff stayed in constant communication with us by phone and email, so we always felt informed and supported. Overall, we feel very lucky to have chosen this team for our roof replacement, and we would highly recommend them to anyone in Plano looking for reliable roofing services!
reviews.author: Reese Baird

reviews.text: Jay was very responsive and got our roofing project scheduled quickly. The installation was completed fast, which we appreciated, especially with the hot Texas weather. Throughout the process, Jay made sure to address any concerns right away. When we noticed a minor issue with the shingles, Jay promptly sent someone out to take care of it, showing real dedication to customer service. The team recommended a particular type of shingle, and while they explained the benefits, they made sure we understood our options and helped us choose what would work best for our home. The value for the service was excellent, and the crew worked efficiently to get the roof finished. Although a few materials and old gutter covers were left behind, the team returned promptly to clean up and ensure everything looked tidy. They even handled a small landscaping mishap with care and took steps to make it right. Overall, we were happy with the quick turnaround, the quality of work, and the professionalism shown. We look forward to seeing how well our new roof holds up and feel confident knowing the crew will stand by their work.
reviews.author: katelyn malone

reviews.text: Working with Scott and his team was a fantastic experience from start to finish. Even though the Plano weather caused a few delays, Scott kept us updated every step of the way and made sure we always knew what was going on with our roof replacement. There are several reasons we highly recommend this roofing crew: 1) Scott took the time to get to know our family, and it really felt like he cared about us as customers. His wife and son even stopped by to lend a hand, which made the whole process feel more personal and friendly. We even made plans to golf together—now that’s great customer service! 2) Scott was right there on the roof with his crew, working hard alongside them. He doesn’t just subcontract out the job; he knows his team well and treats everyone with respect. It was clear they all enjoyed working together—you could hear them laughing and having fun while getting the work done. 3) They kept the energy up with an awesome playlist, which made the worksite atmosphere upbeat. 4) Scott was organized and quick to handle all the necessary paperwork, which made things easy and stress-free for us. 5) After we picked out our shingle color and set a date, we didn’t have to worry about a single thing. The process was smooth and easy. 6) Scott is honest and straightforward, always making sure we understood what was happening and that we were comfortable with every step. 7) He made sure we were completely happy with our new roof before wrapping up the job. 8) With little kids running around outside, I was worried about nails or debris being left behind. But their clean-up was excellent—we haven’t found a single nail in the yard. If you’re looking for a roofer in Plano, you can’t go wrong with this team. They did an outstanding job and we couldn’t be happier with our new roof!
reviews.author: Paula Hartman

reviews.text: I couldn't be more pleased with the excellent job this roofing company did installing a metal roof on my home in Plano. From the very beginning, their service truly stood out. Bryan and the rest of the crew were not just professional but also highly skilled at what they do. They showed up right on time and you could tell they paid close attention to every detail as soon as the installation began. The team worked carefully and made sure every part of the project was done just right. They really went above and beyond my expectations, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone who needs roofing work done. If you want a roofer that brings experience, professionalism, and a focus on quality, this is the company to call. Thanks to them, I have a strong and attractive metal roof that will keep my home safe for years. Great job to the whole team!
reviews.author: Nina Little

reviews.text: If you had told me that getting a new roof put on would be simple and stress-free, I probably wouldn’t have believed you. But after working with Thomas & Sons Roofing & Construction, I can honestly say it was a smooth experience. Eduardo came by for the estimate and brought a whole bag of roofing samples. He walked me through all the options and explained every step in plain language, so I understood exactly what my home needed—and also what I didn’t. Out of all the roofing companies I talked to, no one else gave me as much detail or transparency. Eduardo gave me a full quote right there on the spot, while other places made me wait days. I felt like he really cared about what would work best for my roof, rather than just trying to sell me something extra. The day before installation, Scott, the Field Supervisor, called to make sure everything was ready to go. On installation day, his team worked incredibly hard under the Texas sun, finishing my whole roof in just one day. I was genuinely impressed by how much they got done and how great the roof looked afterward. Scott also took the time to answer my questions about the process and made sure his crew stayed safe and hydrated in the heat. By the end of the day, my yard was spotless—probably even cleaner than it was before they started! The cleanup was outstanding. After getting several quotes, I learned that roofing isn’t just about price—some companies wanted to use lower-quality shingles or charge for things I didn’t need. Here, I was offered high-quality shingles with a long-lasting warranty and solid workmanship. I really felt like I could trust them with such an important investment in my home. They got me scheduled quickly, delivered top-notch work, and treated me with great customer service. I highly recommend them to anyone needing a new roof.
reviews.author: Aidan B

reviews.text: We want to sincerely thank the entire roofing team for the excellent job they did on our roof replacement. From the very start, Scott and Bryan came out to assess our roof and worked closely with our insurance company and all the other parties involved. They made several visits to our house, always arriving early and showing great professionalism and knowledge, making sure we had all the information we needed. Their communication and follow-up were outstanding, which really helped move the process along smoothly. Scott and Bryan were especially helpful in guiding us through decisions about the style and color of our new roof tiles, which wasn’t easy for us. Once everything was finalized and the work was ready to begin, Todd took over as the project manager. He was amazing—very detail-oriented and always kept us updated. We didn’t know much about roofing before this project, but Todd took the time to explain everything, like the different options for gutters and downspouts, and helped us pick the best color choices. He stayed in touch throughout and made sure every detail was covered so the final result would turn out great. Thanks to the whole team’s attention to detail and excellent communication, our new roof looks fantastic. We’ve even had neighbors and strangers stop by to tell us how much they admire it. One interior designer even said it’s the nicest roof they’ve seen! We appreciate all the hard work and dedication from Scott, Bryan, Todd, and the rest of the crew. We are truly happy with our new roof and would highly recommend this team to anyone needing roofing services in Texas.
reviews.author: Joy Robbins

reviews.text: I want to give a big shout out for the outstanding job done on my recent roof installation. From the start, everyone I dealt with—from the office team and the estimator, all the way to the crew who put on the shingles—was incredibly professional and organized. The company handled everything smoothly and their workmanship was top-notch. I especially want to mention Bryan, who took care of my project from the first inspection all the way until the last shingle was placed. He was always helpful and made the process with my insurance adjuster easy and stress-free. I absolutely recommend this roofing company to anyone needing roof repairs or a new roof, especially with how hot the weather gets here in Texas.
reviews.author: Gina Davies

reviews.text: Our condo building in Plano had Thomas & Sons Roofing & Construction come out to check our roof. Their team, including Bryan, was upfront and let us know the roof could last a bit longer before needing a full replacement. We had a couple of holes in the gables that needed quick fixing, and our old skylights were ready to be replaced. The crew handled both jobs smoothly. They were professional, efficient, and took care of a few extra small repairs without charging us more. We’re very happy with their work and definitely plan to have them install our new roof when the time comes. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Braden Sweeney
